Hi Sam —

Great to meet you and the BrightData team on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Key use case: serving low-latency summarization and reranking across customer-facing workflows (support & search).
- Scale: ~5M monthly queries today, expecting 2–3x growth over the next 12 months.
- Constraints: strict PII routing (EU data centers), and a need for predictable 95th pct latency at <=250ms per token.

Suggested next step: a 30–45m technical deep-dive/demo where we:
1) show a short latency/cost demo of the model variants (quantized vs fp16),
2) walk through routing & caching config for your traffic pattern, and
3) surface integration points for your infra/security team.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 4/27, 10:00–10:30am PT
- Wed 4/28, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Thu 4/29, 11:00–11:45am PT

If none of those work, happy to reschedule — if possible please confirm by EOD Monday so we can lock a room with our engineering lead. I’ve attached a one-pager and a proposed demo agenda to help your team prep.

Calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m?candidate=marissa

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference
